en.headline: 204 auxiliary police officers graduate, including barrister and government statistician
en.dek: The new batch of part-time officers from diverse professions completed training and will support frontline policing across Hong Kong.
body: The Hong Kong Auxiliary Police Force held a passing-out parade on Saturday for 204 new officers, comprising 136 men and 68 women drawn from a wide range of civilian careers including engineers, teachers, finance professionals and interior designers.

Among the graduates was practising barrister Michelle Yau, a Hong Kong accredited mediator and member of the Chartered Institute of Arbitrators, who said she hoped to combine her legal expertise with auxiliary police duties to serve the community. Another graduate, government statistician Jason Ng, who works on big-data analysis and artificial-intelligence projects, received the Silver Whistle Award for outstanding performance. He said frontline experience would help him bring greater empathy and practical insight to his statistical work.

Ng added that the disciplined training had fulfilled a childhood ambition after he was unable to join the Scouts because of his weight. Both graduates expressed commitment to supporting regular officers in maintaining public safety.

zh.headline: 204名輔警結業 大律師及政府統計師跨界投身前線
zh.dek: 結業會操見證來自各行各業的學員完成訓練，包括執業大律師及統計師，將投入支援正規警隊工作。
body: 香港輔助警察隊周六舉行結業會操，共有204名輔警警員（136男、68女）畢業，正式投入警務工作。學員來自各行各業，包括工程師、教師、金融從業員及室內設計師等。
執業大律師邱紫君同時是香港認可調解員及英國特許仲裁司學會會員，表示希望結合法律專業與輔警經驗，為市民服務。另一名畢業學員、政府統計師吳海俊負責大數據分析及人工智能項目，以優異表現獲頒銀笛獎。他指前線經驗有助日後分析更貼地及具同理心。
吳海俊表示，童年因體重未能加入童軍一直是憾事，輔警訓練正好彌補。兩人皆表明會全力支援正規警隊，守護市民安全。
